title: Blood Orange Sorbet
changes_from_base: Blood orange juice and a zest-infused syrup replace the mango purée.
summary: Ruby-red and sweet-sharp: fresh blood orange juice stirred into a syrup infused with the orange zest.

ingredients.item: strips of blood orange zest, pared with a peeler
light corn syrup or glucose syrup

steps.title: Zest
steps.text: Peel the zest from two of the oranges in wide strips with a vegetable peeler, leaving the bitter white pith behind.

steps.title: Syrup
steps.text: Warm the zest strips with the sugar, water and corn syrup, stirring, just until the sugar dissolves. Cool, chill, then lift out the zest.

steps.title: Juice
steps.text: Squeeze the oranges and lemon, then sieve the juice into the cold syrup and stir.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn for 20-25 min until it holds a soft peak, then freeze for at least 2 h. Its colour is deep ruby; serve it with orange segments.

tips: Blood oranges are in season in winter; ordinary oranges also work but the colour is paler.
Keep the pith off the zest strips, as it is bitter.
Serve with thin orange slices and a few pistachios.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
